summary.headline: Sentence drill reviewing tool words (aa5er, awal, taani), idafa and verb + preposition pairs

rules.title: aa5er / awal + pronoun = the end / beginning of it, with no el-: aa5ero
bullets: aa5er and awal take a pronoun ending like a noun
the pronoun makes it definite, so no el-
aa5ero = the end of it, awalhom = the first of them

examples.line: أول الفيلم منيح بس ما حبيت آخره - the start of the film was good but I didn't like its end
كلنا / كلهم - all of us / all of them

rules.title: taani after a definite noun takes el-: sa7abak el-taani
bullets: a noun with a pronoun ending is definite
so the adjective after it needs el-
taani before the noun means second only

rules.title: My first day: yawmi el-awal or awal yawm ili
bullets: awal yawmi = the beginning of my day, not my first day
way 1: treat awal as an adjective after the noun

examples.line: هذا أول يوم إلي - this is my first day

rules.title: Verb + preposition pairs in a sentence

examples.line: ضايقة عليهم آخر الفيلم - upset for them at the end of the film
جاوبت على أغلب الأسئلة - I answered most of the questions
طلبت غير إشي منهم - I asked them for something else
الإشي المفضل عندي لما أتطلع على الطبيعة - my favourite thing is when I look at nature

rules.title: bi3asseb as an adjective: the news was enraging = kanu bi3assbu
bullets: the b- present form works as an adjective: enraging
akhbaar is plural (khabar = one piece of news), so kanu

examples.line: بيعصب بس كان أو كانوا - enraging, but was or were

rules.title: A plural can be treated as feminine: 7uroob taanye
bullets: you may hear plurals with a feminine adjective
she skipped this rule before; you don't need it, but taanye is fine
